person (#1019) — the in-app drill-down behind the edition/person payment
summaries; ``/transactions/export`` covers the CSV download of the same
filtered set (always chronological, regardless of `sort`).

Paginated and sortable (#1032), mirroring ``list_registrations``: a real
``COUNT(*)`` backs `total` (cheap at this table's realistic scale — "low
thousands per year" per #1032, unlike the unbounded row fetch this
replaced), and `sort`/`sort_dir` let an admin pick newest-first (or by
amount) instead of the fixed oldest-first order a plain offset-paginated
list without a keyset cursor (see `build_ledger_query`) would otherwise
be stuck with.

get.description:
Per-event guest counts, checked-in vs. total, for a live progress display at the entrance.

Counts guests (`sum(guest_count)`), not bookings, matching the admin's own capacity panel
(`RegistrationList.tsx`'s `eventCapacityStats`) — a booking can carry several guests, and a
headcount is what a live entrance display and a capacity limit both actually care about.
Registered but cancelled bookings are excluded from both counts, since they were never
going to show up. Kept separate from the public `/api/editions/active` payload (and from
`EventOut`) since check-in progress is volunteer/admin-only information.

geometry and its areas (stands, stage, entrance, ...) — nothing from tables,
registrations or allocations (see `app.services.stands_service`). Published in

get.description:
SSE stream of invalidation events for event-day operational views.

Requires the ``volunteer`` or ``admin`` realm role.
Accepts optional ``?edition_id=`` and ``?event_id=`` scope filters.
Emits ``event: invalidate`` frames; clients call
``queryClient.invalidateQueries`` for each key in the payload.
Sends ``: keepalive`` comments every 15 s to keep reverse proxies alive.
Fast alive check — no DB hit. Suitable for load-balancer liveness probes.

DB + OIDC connectivity check.

Returns 200 when both the database and OIDC JWKS endpoint are reachable, 503 otherwise.
Suitable for load-balancer readiness probes.
Summary health response with links to liveness and readiness probes.

HMAC-protected endpoint returning uptime, request rate, error rate and latency percentiles.

Pass a fresh ``<unix-timestamp>:<hex-hmac-sha256>`` token in the
``X-Metrics-Token`` request header (see ``build_metrics_token``); tokens
older than ``METRICS_TOKEN_MAX_AGE_SECONDS`` are rejected.

These figures are per-process (``InMemoryRequestMetrics`` is not aggregated
across API workers). A snapshot represents the whole API only when one
worker serves all requests; the response labels this with ``per_process``.

sponsor_tiers.description: Sponsor level per lineup sponsor (organization id -> tier); sponsors without one are untiered.

sponsor_tier.title: Sponsor Tier
sponsor_tier.description: Sponsor level for this edition; null for non-sponsors and untiered sponsors.

EditionItemOut.title: EditionItemOut
EditionItemOut.description:
Slim organization shape embedded in the public edition response.
Only active items are included; contact person and active flag are
intentionally excluded — they are internal admin data.

organizations.title: Organizations
organizations.description: The lineup organization ids in admin-defined order.

sponsors.title: Sponsors
sponsors.description: Ordered by sponsor tier (main first), then lineup order.

flyer_image.title: Flyer Image
flyer_image.description: Uploaded flyer path, or null for the static default.

hero_image.title: Hero Image
hero_image.description: Uploaded hero photo path, or null for the static default.

share_image.title: Share Image
share_image.description: Uploaded 1200x630 sharing image path (`og:image`), or null for the default.

EditionPlanOut.title: EditionPlanOut
EditionPlanOut.description:
Returned by the unauthenticated ``GET /api/editions/{id}/plan`` (#1253).

Only rooms and areas: there are no tables, registrations, guests, capacities
or allocations in this shape.

sponsors.title: Sponsors
sponsors.description: Ordered by sponsor tier (main first), then lineup order.

flyer_image.title: Flyer Image
flyer_image.description: Uploaded flyer path, or null for the static default.

hero_image.title: Hero Image
hero_image.description: Uploaded hero photo path, or null for the static default.

share_image.title: Share Image
share_image.description: Uploaded 1200x630 sharing image path (`og:image`), or null for the default.

EditionPublicOut.title: EditionPublicOut
EditionPublicOut.description:
Returned by the unauthenticated /api/editions/active and /upcoming
endpoints — events carry EventPublicOut, never the admin product shape.

EditionStandsOut.title: EditionStandsOut
EditionStandsOut.description:
Returned by the unauthenticated ``GET /api/editions/{id}/stands``.

Only lineup organizations that have at least one stand appear; there are no
tables, registrations, guests, capacities or allocations in this shape.

sponsor_tiers.title: Sponsor Tiers
sponsor_tiers.description: Replaces the sponsor levels when given. When omitted, existing levels are kept for sponsors that stay in the lineup.

key.title: Key
key.description: Stable identifier consent records point at: lowercase letters, digits, `-` and `_`. Cannot be changed.

allowed_roles.title: Allowed Roles
allowed_roles.description: Roles that may use the category (any one of them, not retired); empty means everyone.

EmailCategoryUpdate.title: EmailCategoryUpdate
EmailCategoryUpdate.description: Partial update; the key is immutable and `automatic` is not editable.

consents.title: Consents
consents.description: Category key to the wanted state; categories that are not listed stay unchanged.

EventCheckInStats.title: EventCheckInStats
EventCheckInStats.description:
Guest counts for an event's live entrance display. `total`/`checked_in`
are guest headcounts (sum of `guest_count`), not booking counts.

EventPublicOut.title: EventPublicOut
EventPublicOut.description:
Visitor-facing event shape — see ProductPublicOut for why `products`
differs from `EventOut.products`.

ExpiredPlaylist.title: ExpiredPlaylist
ExpiredPlaylist.description: What an expired export keeps of its snapshot: durations only, never content.

FaqItemOut.title: FaqItemOut
FaqItemOut.description: Admin shape: every language's content, for the FAQ editor.

FaqItemPublicOut.title: FaqItemPublicOut
FaqItemPublicOut.description:
Public shape: one locale's question/answer, already resolved server-side
(Dutch when that locale is not fully translated).

FaqItemReorder.title: FaqItemReorder
FaqItemReorder.description:
The complete, ordered list of every existing FAQ item's ID.

`sort_order` isn't settable through create/update — this is the only way
to change display order, and it takes the whole collection at once so a
reorder can't leave things ambiguous or race another admin's reorder (#836).

FaqItemUpdate.title: FaqItemUpdate
FaqItemUpdate.description: Partial update: an empty string clears a translation, the Dutch text cannot be cleared.

IntegrationClientCreatedOut.title: IntegrationClientCreatedOut
IntegrationClientCreatedOut.description:
Returned only from create/rotate: carries the one-time raw key.

The raw key is never stored and never retrievable again after this
response — only its hash persists.

IntegrationClientOut.title: IntegrationClientOut
IntegrationClientOut.description: Admin listing/detail shape — never includes the key hash or raw key.

LayoutBulkCreate.title: LayoutBulkCreate
LayoutBulkCreate.description:
Create several layouts in one atomic transaction (#837).

All items are validated and, within the batch, checked against each other
for the same room+event duplication ``create_layout`` already
rejects — a failure partway through leaves no layout created. Pass
``idempotency_key`` to safely retry after a timeout or partial failure
without risking duplicates.

LayoutRestoreAllocationConflict.title: LayoutRestoreAllocationConflict
LayoutRestoreAllocationConflict.description:
One live allocation that would be silently invalidated by a restore.

Restoring never touches ``Registration``/``Area.organization_id`` itself —
this only flags that the *geometry* change (delete/move) would orphan an
existing allocation, so the caller can make a deliberate call via
``LayoutRestoreRequest.resolve_allocations``.

LayoutRevisionDiff.title: LayoutRevisionDiff
LayoutRevisionDiff.description:
Result of comparing two snapshots (each a revision or the live ``current``
draft), matching tables/areas by stable ``id`` rather than name/label.

LayoutRevisionSnapshot.title: LayoutRevisionSnapshot
LayoutRevisionSnapshot.description:
A geometry-only snapshot of a layout's tables and areas.

Excludes allocations (``Registration``/``RegistrationAllocation``) and
area ``organization_id`` — those remain live operational data outside any
revision's scope (#1021 acceptance criteria).

x.title: X
x.description: Horizontal position: percentage [0, 100] of the layout's rendered canvas width, from the left edge. See docs/floor-plan-coordinates.md.

y.title: Y
y.description: Vertical position: percentage [0, 100] of the layout's rendered canvas height, from the top edge. See docs/floor-plan-coordinates.md.

rotation.title: Rotation
rotation.description: Clockwise rotation in whole degrees [0, 359], pivoting around this element's own center.

LayoutRevisionSnapshotArea.title: LayoutRevisionSnapshotArea
LayoutRevisionSnapshotArea.description:
One area's stable identity and geometry, captured at save-revision time.

``id`` is the source ``Area.id`` — the stable identity compare/restore
match on, never the mutable ``label``. Deliberately excludes
``organization_id``: allocations are live operational data, not part of any
revision (see ``LayoutRevisionSnapshot``).

x.title: X
x.description: Horizontal position: percentage [0, 100] of the layout's rendered canvas width, from the left edge. See docs/floor-plan-coordinates.md.

y.title: Y
y.description: Vertical position: percentage [0, 100] of the layout's rendered canvas height, from the top edge. See docs/floor-plan-coordinates.md.

rotation.title: Rotation
rotation.description: Clockwise rotation in whole degrees [0, 359], pivoting around this element's own center.

LayoutRevisionSnapshotTable.title: LayoutRevisionSnapshotTable
LayoutRevisionSnapshotTable.description:
One table's stable identity and geometry, captured at save-revision time.

``id`` is the source ``Table.id`` — the stable identity compare/restore
match on, never the mutable ``name``.

LayoutWithTablesOut.title: LayoutWithTablesOut
LayoutWithTablesOut.description:
``LayoutOut`` plus its tables/areas, returned by ``GET /api/layouts/{id}``
when ``include_tables=true`` is passed (or the MCP ``get_layout`` tool's
``include_tables`` argument). ``tables``/``areas`` are ``None`` unless
requested, so a scoped single-layout read no longer requires a separate
global ``list_tables``/``list_areas`` scan and client-side join.

MetricsOut.title: MetricsOut
MetricsOut.description: Per-process request metrics (``per_process`` is always true).

MyRegistrationOut.title: MyRegistrationOut
MyRegistrationOut.description: Registration item returned from the authenticated visitor self-service API.

OidcDiscoveryConfig.title: OidcDiscoveryConfig
OidcDiscoveryConfig.description: Public OIDC endpoints discovered by native clients from the API.

OkOut.title: OkOut
OkOut.description: Acknowledges a retry-safe public write; ``true`` also for an idempotent replay.

OrderItemRequest.title: OrderItemRequest
OrderItemRequest.description:
What a registration request supplies for an order line item.

Only `product_id` and `quantity` are client-supplied; `name`/`price`/`category`
are resolved server-side against the event's real products (see
`app.services.registrations_service.resolve_order_items`) so a client can never set an
arbitrary or zero price, or order a product that doesn't exist.

OutboxJobListEnvelope.title: OutboxJobListEnvelope
OutboxJobListEnvelope.description:
Paginated response for the outbox diagnostics list.

``total`` counts every job matching the current filter, not just this page,
so a client can tell ``items`` was truncated instead of reading a partial
list as if it were complete. Mirrors ``RegistrationListEnvelope``.

PaymentTransactionCreate.title: PaymentTransactionCreate
PaymentTransactionCreate.description:
One append-only ledger entry against a booking (#1019).

There's no ``kind``: a positive ``amount`` is a payment, a negative one
is a refund — that sign is the only distinction the system needs.
``amount != 0`` is validated in ``app.services.payments_service`` rather
than here, so REST and MCP share one rule. Never edits or deletes a
prior entry — a refund is always a new row, optionally linked to the
entry it reverses via ``reversed_transaction_id``.

PaymentTransactionLedgerEnvelope.title: PaymentTransactionLedgerEnvelope
PaymentTransactionLedgerEnvelope.description:
Paginated response for the edition/person ledger drill-down (#1032),
mirroring ``RegistrationListEnvelope``: ``total`` counts every row
matching the current filters, not just this page.

PaymentTransactionLedgerRow.title: PaymentTransactionLedgerRow
PaymentTransactionLedgerRow.description:
One ledger entry with the booking context needed to render an
edition- or person-level ledger view (#1019), so the admin UI doesn't
need a round trip per row to resolve which booking/person it belongs to.

PersonAdminSummaryOut.title: PersonAdminSummaryOut
PersonAdminSummaryOut.description:
``PersonOut`` without the volunteer-only identity fields.

Used for the general people/members list and single-person reads, which
have no business rendering a NISS/eID that belongs to a small subset of
rows — see docs/decisions/934-data-retention-and-erasure.md. Create,
update, and merge keep returning the full ``PersonOut`` unchanged: those
responses echo back data the caller just explicitly provided or is
actively verifying (e.g. a merge adopting an identity field from a
duplicate), not passive browsing.

PersonListEnvelope.title: PersonListEnvelope
PersonListEnvelope.description:
Paginated response for the admin people/members lists.

``total`` counts every row matching the current filters, not just this
page, so a client can tell ``items`` was truncated instead of silently
rendering a partial result as if it were complete — see
``RegistrationListEnvelope``, which this mirrors.

PersonPaymentSummary.title: PersonPaymentSummary
PersonPaymentSummary.description:
Received/refunded/net paid/due/outstanding/refund-liability across one
person's non-cancelled bookings (#1019) — traceable to their payment
ledger entries, the person-level counterpart to ``EditionAttendanceStats``.

PersonSummaryOut.title: PersonSummaryOut
PersonSummaryOut.description:
Minimal person projection used in public-facing reservation responses.

Omits sensitive/admin-only fields so that the public reservation endpoints
cannot leak PII (address, roles, national register number, notes, etc.).

PlanAreaOut.title: PlanAreaOut
PlanAreaOut.description:
One area (stand, stage, entrance, catering, ...) of the public floor plan.

Geometry follows ``docs/floor-plan-coordinates.md``. Deliberately has no layout id.

PolicyDraftCreate.title: PolicyDraftCreate
PolicyDraftCreate.description:
Seed a new draft.

Omit ``source_version_number`` to copy the current published version (the
normal "edit from current" flow). Pass an older, historical version's
number instead to seed a rollback draft with that version's content —
publishing it is what actually performs the rollback.

PolicyDraftUpdate.title: PolicyDraftUpdate
PolicyDraftUpdate.description: Edit the open draft. The draft may be incomplete; publishing requires Dutch text.

PolicyOut.title: PolicyOut
PolicyOut.description: Admin shape: the policy plus its full version history, newest first.

PolicyRenderRequest.title: PolicyRenderRequest
PolicyRenderRequest.description:
Render arbitrary, not-yet-saved Markdown for live preview.

Uses the exact same renderer/sanitizer as the public endpoint, so what an
admin previews here is guaranteed to match what publishing would produce.

PolicyVersionOut.title: PolicyVersionOut
PolicyVersionOut.description: Admin shape: full per-locale Markdown source and provenance for one version.

PollAttendanceItem.title: PollAttendanceItem
PollAttendanceItem.description:
One volunteer's answer to a yes/no question: `people` counts everyone a "yes" stands for
(the volunteer included) and is 0 for a "no".

PollOptionOut.title: PollOptionOut
PollOptionOut.description: An option as the admin sees it, with how much volunteers asked for in total.

PollOptionReorder.title: PollOptionReorder
PollOptionReorder.description: Every option of an option-bearing question, in the order volunteers should see them.

PollOptionUpdate.title: PollOptionUpdate
PollOptionUpdate.description: Partial update: an empty string clears a translation; `dietary_tags` replaces the whole list.

PollOrdersOut.title: PollOrdersOut
PollOrdersOut.description:
Who answered what: every active volunteer (also those who have not answered yet) and anyone else
holding an answer, next to the questions in display order.

PollQuestionCopy.title: PollQuestionCopy
PollQuestionCopy.description:
Copy the questions (and their options) of one edition into another; a question whose kind and Dutch
title already exist there is skipped.

PollQuestionReorder.title: PollQuestionReorder
PollQuestionReorder.description: Every question of an edition, in the order volunteers should see them.

ProductChangePreviewOut.title: ProductChangePreviewOut
ProductChangePreviewOut.description:
What saving a product change would do to existing bookings, without saving it.

Send ``preview_token`` back with the save to confirm this exact preview was reviewed.

ProductPublicOut.title: ProductPublicOut
ProductPublicOut.description:
The visitor-facing shape of a product: always `purchasable=True` —
see app.utils.event_to_summary_dict, which excludes every hidden
(`purchasable=False`) product from the public response entirely, and
strips any `inclusions`/`included_product_id` edge that targets one.

RegistrationAdminCreate.title: RegistrationAdminCreate
RegistrationAdminCreate.description: Admin-only registration creation — skips spam checks, accepts person_id directly.

new_editions_opt_in.title: New Editions Opt In
new_editions_opt_in.description: Explicit, unticked-by-default wish to be mailed when registrations open for a new edition — a separate legal basis from the operational registration purpose. It only becomes consent (category `new_editions`) once the email address is verified: directly for a signed-in person using their own verified address, otherwise through an emailed confirmation link. Never implied.

RegistrationDeliveryUpdate.title: RegistrationDeliveryUpdate
RegistrationDeliveryUpdate.description: The only order-line fields an entrance volunteer may change.

RegistrationListEnvelope.title: RegistrationListEnvelope
RegistrationListEnvelope.description:
Paginated response for the admin registration list.

``total`` counts every row matching the current filters, not just this
page, so a client can tell ``items`` was truncated (e.g. render "showing
20 of 143 matches") instead of silently rendering a partial result as if
it were complete.

RegistrationOutWithToken.title: RegistrationOutWithToken
RegistrationOutWithToken.description:
Full registration including the sensitive check-in token.
Only returned by the admin detail endpoint.

RegistrationVolunteerAssignment.title: RegistrationVolunteerAssignment
RegistrationVolunteerAssignment.description:
Admin override (#1044) attaching an unowned registration to a
volunteer's own portal account, for a booking the volunteer never
confirmed themselves via the self-service claim flow — e.g. they don't
use the account much, or the booking predates their self-registration.

RoleStretchOut.title: RoleStretchOut
RoleStretchOut.description: One stretch of holding a role; ``started_on`` is null when the start is unknown.

RoomBulkCreate.title: RoomBulkCreate
RoomBulkCreate.description:
Create several rooms in one atomic transaction (#837).

A failure partway through (e.g. an unknown ``venue_id`` on any item)
leaves no room created. Pass ``idempotency_key`` to safely retry after a
timeout or partial failure without risking duplicates.

SignageAssetOut.title: SignageAssetOut
SignageAssetOut.description: The public URL of an uploaded signage image.

StandOut.title: StandOut
StandOut.description:
One stand of one organization on one festival day (public subset of an ``Area``).

Deliberately carries no coordinates, size, icon or layout/area ids: the
public list answers "where is X?" by label, room and day only.

TableBulkCreate.title: TableBulkCreate
TableBulkCreate.description:
Create several tables in one atomic transaction (#837).

A failure partway through (e.g. an unknown ``table_type_id`` or
``layout_id`` on any item) leaves no table created. Pass
``idempotency_key`` to safely retry after a timeout or partial failure
without risking duplicates.

x.title: X
x.description: Horizontal position: percentage [0, 100] of the layout's rendered canvas width, from the left edge. See docs/floor-plan-coordinates.md.

y.title: Y
y.description: Vertical position: percentage [0, 100] of the layout's rendered canvas height, from the top edge. See docs/floor-plan-coordinates.md.

rotation.title: Rotation
rotation.description: Clockwise rotation in whole degrees [0, 359], pivoting around this element's own center.

TableTypeBulkCreate.title: TableTypeBulkCreate
TableTypeBulkCreate.description:
Create several table types in one atomic transaction (#837).

A failure partway through (e.g. an unknown ``venue_id`` on any item)
leaves no table type created. Pass ``idempotency_key`` to safely retry
after a timeout or partial failure without risking duplicates.

x.title: X
x.description: Horizontal position: percentage [0, 100] of the layout's rendered canvas width, from the left edge. See docs/floor-plan-coordinates.md.

y.title: Y
y.description: Vertical position: percentage [0, 100] of the layout's rendered canvas height, from the top edge. See docs/floor-plan-coordinates.md.

rotation.title: Rotation
rotation.description: Clockwise rotation in whole degrees [0, 359], pivoting around this element's own center.

VideoExportCreatedOut.title: VideoExportCreatedOut
VideoExportCreatedOut.description:
A new export with the playlist snapshot the browser renders slides from.

An idempotent replay of an export that has since expired returns the
tombstone instead of the full playlist.

VideoExportOut.title: VideoExportOut
VideoExportOut.description: One creator-owned video export, as ``services.signage_video.summary`` reports it.

VisitorSessionStatus.title: VisitorSessionStatus
VisitorSessionStatus.description: Whether the caller currently holds a valid visitor session (#953).

VolunteerListEnvelope.title: VolunteerListEnvelope
VolunteerListEnvelope.description: Paginated response for the admin volunteers list. See ``PersonListEnvelope``.

VolunteerPollAnswerIn.title: VolunteerPollAnswerIn
VolunteerPollAnswerIn.description:
A volunteer's answer to one question: `selections` (quantity per option, replacing their picks for
that question) for meals, `attending` (and `people`, default 1) for yes/no, `option_id` for single choice,
`text` (at most 500 characters) for free text, or `rating` (integer 1–5). Explicit null clears a scalar answer.

VolunteerPollNoteIn.title: VolunteerPollNoteIn
VolunteerPollNoteIn.description: The volunteer's dietary note for the edition's meals; an empty string clears it.

VolunteerPollOut.title: VolunteerPollOut
VolunteerPollOut.description:
What a volunteer sees: the active festival edition's questions (empty if none) with their own
answers, and their dietary note.

VolunteerTableOrdersOut.title: VolunteerTableOrdersOut
VolunteerTableOrdersOut.description: PII-free registrations allocated to one table.

VolunteerTableOrdersUnresolvedOut.title: VolunteerTableOrdersUnresolvedOut
VolunteerTableOrdersUnresolvedOut.description: A table reference matching no table, or several, so no orders are listed.

WaitlistEntryListEnvelope.title: WaitlistEntryListEnvelope
WaitlistEntryListEnvelope.description: One page of the queue; ``total`` counts every entry matching the filters.
